newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan trade surplus unlikely to rise quickly -govt.
newsitem.headline: Japan trade surplus unlikely to rise quickly -govt.

text.p: Japan's huge trade surplus is unlikely to rise quickly, although the economic conditions are looking favourable for exporters, Japan's chief government spokesman said on Monday.
"I do not hold the view that the huge (trade) surplus is necessarily rapidly increasing," Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama told a news conference.
"The exporting environment is partly becoming favourable, as it follows the natural movements of the economy. Unless some policy steps are taken, it is going to go in that direction," he said.
